title: Godot 4.4: `play_section_backwards` after `play_section` fail
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.4.stable

### System information

Linux - Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 550.144.03 - Compatibility

### Issue description

Calling `AnimationPlayer.play_section_backwards` after `AnimationPlayer.play_section` with different time section fails to execute animation.
`play_section_backwards` has `start_time` and `end_time` as parameters, so a hidden undocumented requirement to call `AnimationPlayer.seek(end_time)` beforehand looks like a bug (or maybe just missing docs).

### Steps to reproduce

1) call `AnimationPlayer.play_section("idle", start1, end1)`
2) On animation finished call subsequently without switching animation `AnimationPlayer.play_section_backwards("idle", start2, end2)` with `end2 != end1`

Or

1) call `AnimationPlayer.play_section_backwards("idle", start1, end1)`
2) On animation finished call subsequently without switching animation `AnimationPlayer.play_section("idle", start2, end2)` with `start2 != start1`

Both cases fail.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-play_section.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19076607/mrp-play_section.zip)
Expected output:
```
frw 0.0 => 2.0
started 'idle'
done 'idle'
bck 6.0 => 3.0
started 'idle'
done 'idle'
```
Actual output (missing last **done 'idle'**):
```
frw 0.0 => 2.0
started 'idle'
done 'idle'
bck 6.0 => 3.0
started 'idle'
```
